children: ZYUS issued 333,333 units for C$150K, bringing total offering proceeds to approximately C$0.4M; another tranche is expected shortly. Some matured secured loans totaling $0.245M were extended to January 1, 2028, while talks with remaining lenders continue.
Principal and accrued interest were unpaid at maturity; the remaining lenders have not yet agreed to extensions, leaving repayment risk.
Third tranche raised C$150K; total approx. C$0.4M
Adds working capital, but proceeds remain modest relative to the company's funding needs; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Insiders bought all 333,333 units for C$150K
Insider participation provided the entire tranche's funding; it is a related-party transaction.
Granted options on up to 480,000 shares
Potential future dilution; 405,000 options went to senior leadership, exercisable at C$0.50 for five years.

This is a financing and liquidity update for a clinical-stage company, with matured debt and ongoing fundraising indicating near-term funding pressure. Further extensions from remaining lenders and completion of the expected additional offering tranche would clarify repayment and liquidity risk.
